review.reviewBody: When the Splendid Moving trucks first showed up I saw two skinny young guys step out, but don't judge a book by its cover. These two young men professionally and methodically safely moved our stuff. Stairs, steep driveway, heat wave… they've seen it all.

Ali and Adis were amazing helping me with moving all of my stuff! I told them to just put everything where it would be easiest, but they went the extra mile and laid things out in my new apartment in a way that makes it so easy for me to finish unpacking.

I had a great experience with Splendid Moving — the price was very competitive and it was easy to schedule a move. They also waived a fee for us that they often have for extra heavy items (ours was a combo washer/dryer). The crew was quick and respectful.

They were so nice and quick! Took less than 3 hours for a 1 bedroom, down a flight of stairs and up a flight of stairs. The bed frame wouldn't fit out of the room so they completely disassembled it and then REASSEMBLED it for me at the new place!

Very upfront pricing and no hidden charges. Movers communicated the ETA day of, within the 2 hour arrival time frame. They were careful with my items, and were so kind to ask where each box should go. Would absolutely hire them again.

Zack and Adis did a great job on my move. They arrived on time, took really good care of my fragile items such as TVs and mirrors, and they were the most affordable out of 5 other moving companies I quoted.

10/10 would recommend every single time. We loved the Splendid team so much that we booked them a second time and will continue to rebook whenever we move. Our guests are always shocked at how there aren't any scratches on our walls from moving large items.

I ended up with a lot more furniture than I'd originally estimated, but Zack and Adis handled it like real pros. Everything was wrapped properly and handled with a lot of care, especially some bulkier pieces I was worried about.

I hired them for a long distance move. They were timely and efficient. They handled fragile items with care. Most of my stuff was unloaded into storage and I was very pleased with their organizational skills of how everything was stacked.

The crew was very professional, arrived on time, and communicated often. Leading up to the move, they were also incredibly responsive. Nick was the lead and was very communicative throughout the entire process. Great crew! We would definitely hire them again.
